readBefore: the development trial, with no model; the fresh pairs run only after the delivery path succeeds
rule: a fix commit of a repository this project has never launched, changing source (at most three files) and a test file and nothing else but changelog, README or package files; the parent (base) has a committed package-lock.json; the commit's own test files overlaid on the base fail under the hidden argv; the base passes the project test command; the commit passes both

notUsable.tj/commander.js, uuidjs/uuid, ajv-valida: no fix commit in the window examined changes source and a test file with a lockfile at the base
notUsable.axios/axios: every candidate also changes PRE_RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md or PRE_RELEASE_DOCS.md
notUsable.jquery/jquery: the candidates' tests are browser suites this harness does not provision
notUsable.yargs/yargs: TypeScript sources compiled before the tests; not validated, kept in reserve
notUsable.eemeli/yaml: the project's own tests fail at the base on this host (tests/yaml-test-suite is a git submodule the shallow clone does not carry), with npm test and with the suite file excluded

validated.subject: fix: keep unknown config values from becoming test specs (#6244)
fix: support modern RegExp flags in Mocha#grep (#5825)

note: mocha's npm test runs lint, every node suite and a browser suite; the project test command for a task is its own npm run test-node:unit (the unit and node-unit suites under nyc), which the base passes and the upstream passes
